allowed.note: Document is not renderable by the CMP player: ModifierGraphicsLayer[9]: operation is excluded from the cmp-wasm-alpha16 profile
allowed.reason: The Progress-Indicator-Linear set draws through a graphics layer, and CMP/Wasm is not offered that operation: rc-players excludes MODIFIER_GRAPHICS_LAYER from its `CMP_WASM_ALPHA16` profile (RcOperationProfiles) because "Compose's current Wasm graphics-layer surface disappears when this modifier is present" — the operation IS implemented, and the shared/iOS renderer gets it; only browser producers are held back, until that Compose Multiplatform backend behaviour is fixed. So this is not a gap in our player and there is nothing to implement: the whole document reports `ModifierGraphicsLayer[9]: operation is excluded from the cmp-wasm-alpha16 profile`. Observed in actions/runs/33721955693, the first run on rc-players 1.56.1 (`463/475 rendered, 4 allowlisted, 8 failing` — these eight).
